label: c02_bottom_02
text: Good thing we had our Cyclizar to get us across\nthe Asado Desert!

label: c02_bottom_03
text: Let’s give both our Cyclizar a nice wash to clean\noff all that sand.

label: c02_bottom_08
text:
I love my Marill just the way she is, so whenever
she starts to evolve, I do a lucky chant to stop it.\c
“B Button! Put the brakes on this Evolution!”
It works every time!

label: c02_bottom_16
text: Cascarrafa’s battle court is sunk right into\nthe river!

label: c02_bottom_18
text: If you want to head to the upper tiers, just wait\nin front of the elevator here for a moment.

label: c02_bottom_19
text: The river gets pretty deep up ahead! ’Course, if\nyou can move across the water, you’re all set!

label: c02_bottom_20
text: Porto Marinada is across this desert! Make sure\nyou’re prepared for the trip if you plan to go.

label: c02_bottom_31
text: I...I saw a tiny little Pokémon holding a coin!\nWhen I got close, it dropped the coin and ran!\r\nWhat even WAS that thing?

label: c02_bottom_40
text: Maybe I should buy something for my Pokémon\nbefore heading home...

label: c02_bottom_41
text: Why don’t Pokémon like to eat the same things\nI like to eat? I don’t get it.

label: c02_bottom_53
text: The walls look just like cascades of water! I bet\nthey could help train Pokémon to use Waterfall!

label: c02_bottom_54
text: Coming from Zapapico, I’m amazed to see how\nmuch water there is around here!\c\nIt’s a precious resource where I’m from.

label: c02_bottom_60
text: Marill really love the water! They’re Water-type\nPokémon after all!

label: c02_bottom_70
text: Whenever I can’t decide what to eat, I always\nfind myself coming to Jade Palace Garden.

label: c02_center_01
text: This spot is for Cyclizar to rest and recharge.\c\nIt’s the least we can do to thank them for carrying\nus around.

label: c02_center_02
text: They call Cascarrafa the City of Water! I’m sure\nyou can see why!

label: c02_center_14
text: The restaurants here are supposed to be really\ngood! I hear it’s because most of ’em use fresh\r\ningredients brought in from Porto Marinada!

label: c02_center_29
text:
I want to travel all over the place and take lots of
photos while I’m still young.\c
When I’m a little old grandma, I’ll look through
them all and remember the good ol’ days.

label: c02_center_45
text: Seems like the Kofu Lounge is the most renowned\neatery in Cascarrafa!

label: c02_center_46
text: I want to go to the sandwich restaurant on the\nupper level!

label: c02_center_50
text: I’m clueless when it comes to map reading...\nWhich way is north again?

label: c02_center_51
text: North is shown by the green arc in your map app.\nWhy not try locking it so north always points up?

label: c02_center_68
text: Cascarrafa was built on the side of these cliffs!\nThat’s why the city has multiple tiers.

label: c02_center_98
text: Hoo boy, what a shopping spree! Where should\nwe head to next?

label: c02_center_99
text: Let’s hit the market in Porto Marinada and shop\ntill we drop!

label: c02_center_111
text: Oh, Cascarrafa, city of waterrr... ♪\nCarafes are vessels for water, etceteraaa! ♪

label: c02_center_118
text: I heard that before they installed elevators here,\nyou had to ride Cyclizar up and down these cliffs\r\nto reach the different tiers! Sounds rough!

label: c02_center_127
text: It seems only especially talented people are\nallowed to have one of those Tera Orbs that let\r\nyou Terastallize Pokémon.

label: c02_center_128
text: They say that Pokémon can only Terastallize in\nPaldea. Now why on earth might that be?

label: c02_center_143
text: Regular folk like us aren’t allowed to set foot\ninside the Great Crater of Paldea...\c\nI wonder what kind of Pokémon are down there?

label: c02_center_151
text: Stop on by the Kofu Lounge! The renowned\nrestaurant of Gym Leader Kofu is right here!

label: c02_center_165
text: People love coming to Cascarrafa to take photos.\nIt’s such a beautiful city!

label: c02_center_169
text: You’re going to school next year, too, right?\nYou think we’ll make lotsa friends?

label: c02_center_170
text: I can’t wait to live in the school dorms! I won’t\nget told off for eating candy before bed!

label: c02_top_01
text:
Tourists started flocking here after we added lots
of blue around the city.\c
The idea apparently came from Kofu himself
a few years ago.

label: c02_top_07
text: Every kind of sandwich, any way you want!\nCome on over to Every Wich Way!

label: c02_top_22
text: Cascarrafa’s Gym Test is a real doozy!

label: c02_top_23
text: Kofu is the face of Cascarrafa! He’s usually a\nmild, easygoing guy, but he shows off his cool\r\nside when he’s doing his Gym Leader thing!

label: c02_top_31
text: I’d love to do a big bicycle trip sometime, but\nPaldea has too many mountains and valleys.

label: c02_top_32
text: I heard they ride Pokémon other than Cyclizar\nin other regions. Wonder if that’s true?

label: c02_top_36
text: I’ve worked my tail off this month... That means\nI can treat myself to a designer handbag, right?

label: c02_top_38
text: I fancied trying out a new style, so I changed up\nmy hair! Don’t you think it suits me?

label: c02_top_39
text: Errr... Did you get your bangs trimmed?
